title: Ernest Trepagnier and Black Benny
summary: He remembers Trepagnier as a good bass drummer heard at dances, and Black Benny.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Yeah, yeah, exactly, yeah. He was supposed to be a good bass drummer, they tell me.
He was a good bass drummer, he was. Did you hear him in dances too or just on the parade?
Yeah, I heard him in several band dances. He plays pretty good. He was a pretty good drummer. Yeah.
Of course, Louis Armstrong always talks about Black Benny, the drummer uptown around Perdido Street and all that played. Yeah, I remember him too. You got to hear him. I remember him.
